howBedtimeBody: Long press "Hold for Bedtime" at the top of the Daily Insight screen when you go to bed.
howWakeBody: Long press "Hold for Wake Up" when you wake up in the morning.
howCheckInBody: Enter time to fall asleep, time awake during night, satisfaction, optional memo, and 3 CBT-I check-in questions.
howCalculationBody: Your estimated sleep time, sleep efficiency, and stats update automatically.
howInsightBody: During the available period, a Daily Insight is AI-generated.
howReviewBody: Check your recent sleep trends in History and Stats.
guideRestrictionBody:
Improves sleep quality by aligning time in bed with actual sleep time. Keep a consistent wake time and reduce unnecessary time in bed.

This may not be appropriate for everyone. Consult a healthcare professional before making significant changes.
guideStimulusBody: Strengthens the association between bed and sleep. Go to bed only when sleepy, and leave the bed if you cannot sleep, so that "bed = sleep" becomes a habit.
guideCognitiveBody: Helps you notice and revise anxious or unrealistic thoughts about sleep. Softens extreme thinking like "I will never fall asleep" or "tomorrow will be terrible."
guideRelaxationBody: Relaxation techniques such as breathing exercises and body scans to release tension. Practice letting go of racing thoughts before bed.

guideIntro: CBT-I (Cognitive Behavioral Therapy for Insomnia) is an evidence-based approach to sleep problems. It consists of four pillars.
privacyDataBody: Simple CBT-I handles the following sleep-related data: bedtime, wake time, sleep onset latency, wake after sleep onset, sleep satisfaction, CBT-I check-in answers, optional memo, calculated sleep duration and efficiency, and statistics generated from sleep records.
privacyLocalBody: All sleep records, statistics, memos, and app preferences are stored locally on your device using AsyncStorage. No account registration is required. Your data remains on your device unless you delete the app.
privacyAiBody: When generating a Daily Insight, the following structured data is sent to OpenAI API via an API gateway: today's structured sleep metrics (time in bed, sleep onset latency, wake after sleep onset, total sleep time, sleep efficiency, satisfaction), CBT-I check-in results, 7-day statistical averages and trends, and rule engine analysis signals.
privacyExcludedBody: The following is NOT sent to OpenAI: optional memo / free-text notes, past free-text entries, full sleep history, names, email addresses, phone numbers, or other personal identifiers.
privacyPurposeBody: Daily Insight is informational support for sleep habit reflection, not medical diagnosis, treatment, or prescription.
privacyExternalBody: Daily Insight generation uses OpenAI API via an API gateway. The structured sleep data described above is processed by OpenAI.
privacyAbuseBody: Simple CBT-I includes stub support for Apple DeviceCheck to prevent abuse of the free Daily Insight trial. This feature is not currently active. When implemented, it will be used solely to prevent repeated free trial claims and API abuse, not for advertising tracking.
privacySubscriptionBody: Simple CBT-I Pro is available as an auto-renewing subscription (Monthly / 6 Months). Payments are processed by Apple App Store or Google Play. Simple CBT-I does not directly collect or store credit card numbers or bank account information.
privacyAdsBody: Simple CBT-I does not currently display third-party advertising. If this changes, this policy will be updated.
privacyAccountsBody: Simple CBT-I does not require or support user accounts.
privacyUseBody: Data is used for recording and displaying sleep history, calculating statistics and trends, generating Daily Insights via AI, and preventing abuse of free trial features.
privacySharingBody: Simple CBT-I does not sell users' personal data to advertisers or any third parties. Data is shared only with external services necessary for app functionality.
privacyRetentionBody: Sleep records are retained locally on your device for as long as the app is installed. Uninstalling the app removes all local data.
privacyMedicalBody: Simple CBT-I is a self-help sleep journal. It does not provide medical diagnosis, treatment, prescriptions, or emergency services.
privacyChildrenBody: Simple CBT-I is not intended for children under 13.
privacyChangesBody: This policy may be updated to reflect changes in app functionality.
privacyContactBody: For questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us through the app.
termsNatureBody: Simple CBT-I is a self-help sleep journal based on Cognitive Behavioral Therapy for Insomnia (CBT-I) principles.
termsMedicalBody: The app does not provide: medical diagnosis, medical treatment, prescriptions, or emergency medical services. Daily Insight is informational support, not a substitute for professional medical advice.
termsRestrictionBody: Sleep restriction techniques in the CBT-I Guide are educational information. They may not be appropriate for everyone. The app does not automatically modify your sleep schedule. Consult a healthcare professional before significantly changing your sleep patterns.
termsAiBody: Daily Insights are generated by AI based on your recorded data. They should be considered supportive suggestions, not medical recommendations.
termsConsultBody: Users with persistent or severe sleep problems, or concerns about their health, should consult an appropriate healthcare professional.
termsSubscriptionBody: Simple CBT-I Pro is an auto-renewing subscription. Monthly: auto-renews every month unless canceled. 6 Months: auto-renews every 6 months unless canceled. Cancel anytime through your device's subscription management.
termsLiabilityBody: Simple CBT-I is provided "as is" without warranty. The developer is not liable for any health outcomes resulting from use of the app.
